title: When Kubernetes HPA Makes
subtitle: HPA's loop can amplify incidents; choose sane signals, delays, and guardrails.

panels.heading: Scale-chasing latency
panels.caption: HPA sees high CPU, adds pods; cold starts slow more; backlog grows; loop escalates.
panels.note: Cold pods worsen latency; tune warm capacity and loop delay.

panels.heading: Throttled scale-out
panels.caption: Low requests pump utilization; low limits throttle pods; cluster grows but work stalls.
panels.note: Align requests to baseline; avoid tight CPU limits under load.

panels.heading: Intentional autoscaling
panels.caption: Use stable signals, warm minima, gentle downscale, bounded upscale; respect delays.
panels.note: Pick metrics that match bottlenecks; set behavior windows to dampen swings.

strip_title: Guardrails to keep HPA calm in incidents
strip_caption: Turn a fragile loop into a stable one: fix signals, rightsize requests/limits, and add behavior damping.

steps.label: Rightsize CPU requests
steps.detail: Match to steady use, not wishful packing.

steps.label: Avoid tight CPU limits
steps.detail: Prevent CFS throttling during real load.

steps.label: Stabilize downscale
steps.detail: Keep warm pods; delay and step down gently.

steps.label: Bound and pace scale-up
steps.detail: Cap jumps; respect startup and metric lag.

steps.label: Scale on per-pod rate
steps.detail: Prefer per-pod rate over raw backlog size.
